Container.Name: codigate-agent
Container.Overview: Publish services on this server through Codigate (EU-hosted tunnel and login in front of your apps) without opening ports. The agent dials out to the Codigate edge on port 443. Put your ingress rules in /mnt/user/appdata/codigate/codigate.yml, or set Docker discovery to true and label the containers you want to publish (codigate.hostname, codigate.port).

Config.Name: Agent token
Config.Description: Agent token from the Codigate dashboard (Agents).

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Holds codigate.yml with your ingress rules. Not needed with Docker discovery.

Config.Name: Docker discovery
Config.Description: Publish containers by their codigate.hostname labels. Needs Docker API access below.

Config.Name: Docker API
Config.Description: Docker API for discovery, e.g. tcp://socket-proxy:2375 (a read-only docker-socket-proxy with CONTAINERS=1 and EVENTS=1).
